> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Notice: Nexus does not accept external pull requests.**
>
> Nexus is open for everyone to use and explore, but all code and architectural development is maintained exclusively by the core author.
> 
> Any pull request opened by external contributors will be automatically closed. 
> 
> **How to contribute:**
> If you have a feature request, question, or bug report, please open an issue on our [Issues page](https://github.com/sabburi1994/nexus/issues) instead. We appreciate your feedback!
